description: This file defines the SaleCoupon controller class for the OpenCart admin report extension, handling display, saving, and reporting of sale coupon data.

classes.name: SaleCoupon
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale coupon reports in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the sale coupon report form page with breadcrumbs and configuration data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of sale coupon report settings, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the sale coupon report list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs the sale coupon report list.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Generates and returns the sale coupon report data as a view, including pagination and filters.
